title: 80' Palmer Johnson ZOOOM Sold by Giovanni Tummolillo and Ralph Navarro of FYI Yachts
description: Palmer Johnson 80 yacht, built in 1993 and known for luxury and performance, was sold for $452,000, marking a significant acquisition.
html:
80′ Palmer Johnson Sold for $452,000

The Palmer Johnson 80, known as ZOOOM, an 80′ yacht built in 1993, has been successfully sold. This vessel, known for its robust design and performance, represents a significant acquisition for its new owner. The yacht’s sale marks the end of its listing period, during which it was offered at a last asking price of $452,000.

ZOOOM is renowned for its sleek design and superior craftsmanship. Built by the esteemed Palmer Johnson shipyard, the yacht features a classic exterior with a spacious deck layout. Its design emphasizes both luxury and functionality, making it suitable for both leisure cruising and more extended voyages. The yacht’s performance is supported by a powerful engine setup, ensuring a smooth and efficient ride.

FYI Yachts Brokers Tummolillo & Navarro Close Deal

Giovanni Tummolillo and Ralph Navarro of FYI Yachts facilitated the sale of ZOOOM. Their expertise in yacht brokerage played a crucial role in closing the deal, ensuring a seamless transaction for both the buyer and seller. The yacht was located in the United States at the time of sale, further enhancing its appeal to potential buyers in the region.

The yacht’s interior is designed to provide comfort and luxury, featuring multiple cabins and a well-appointed salon. The layout is optimized for both relaxation and entertainment, with ample space for guests.

The sale of ZOOOM at $452,000 reflects the yacht’s enduring value and appeal in the pre-owned yacht market. Similar listings continue to attract interest from buyers seeking quality and performance in a classic design.
